extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF figure captions and body text; bounded to membrane-interaction/disruption evidence and not promoted beyond local source support.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GN1 and GP1 adopt alpha-helical structure in DPC micelles, supporting membrane-environment folding for the leading peptides.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GN1 and GP1, with GN2 discussed as a secondary active peptide
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD supports secondary-structure adoption in a membrane mimic; it does not alone prove bactericidal membrane rupture for every generated peptide.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: MD simulations support amphiphilic helical behavior of GN1, GP1, and GN2 in DPC micelles, but this remains computational support rather than a standalone direct killing assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational mechanism support is kept separate from direct experimental mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM imaging after GN1 exposure supports membrane/cell-envelope disruption in Pseudomonas aeruginosa and altered cell contents in Acinetobacter baumannii.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GN1 against Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Acinetobacter baumannii
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM supports membrane-disruption morphology for GN1 only; it is not generalized as direct evidence for every generated peptide.
